public class Strings {
    String text = """
        Hello
        world\n
        """;

    /**
     * Builds the lookup.
     * @param id the key
     */
    String query(String id) {
        String sql = "SELECT name FROM users WHERE id = '" + id + "'";
        String path = "/etc/" + id;
        String url = "https://example.invalid/" + id;
        char quote = '"';
        return String.format("%s:%d", sql, 3) + path + url + quote;
    }
}
